comparison.objective: Release an anti-theft tag clutch with a magnetic detacher and pull its pin; candidate commissions a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Precisely seat a detacher while pulling a pin bimanually versus insert and withdraw a hex bit, rotate a collar, relock it and tune from impacts.
comparison.success_condition: Clutch must be released before extracting the pin, followed by hands-off separation; candidate requires two compliant physical impact cycles with no drift or damage.
comparison.reason: Both use gated release followed by manipulation, but one tests clutch release and pin extraction while the other tests adjustment retention and dynamic damping.
